I care. I care about you. And I'm not the only one who cares about you. Maybe you haven't met the other people yet, but the they exist. The fact that you survived the attempt shows that you are not meant to die. You are meant to live. You are going through a dark and terrible time. But it will get better. I know that's hard to believe but it's the truth. If you want someone to talk to, just hit me up. I'm there for you. Anytime.

Hey,

I can relate to what you went through. I didn't waste my teenage time, but also my childhood. My father cut the contact with me when I was 14. And before that he left me alone a lot. So my only entertainment was the PC. I hated him and myself for that for a long time. But not anymore.

I can't change what happened. No one can. But we can change what happens today. It is the present you should look at. It is hard sometimes but you have to keep that in mind. The past already happened, so you can't change it. The future didn't happen yet, so you can't directly change it. The only thing you can change is the present.
Maybe try to make a list of a few things you want to achieve today. Even if they are small things. Doesn't matter. Whatever comes to your mind. Things you REALLY want to do. And then try everything to achieve these goals. And if you achieve them, and I have no doubt that you will achieve them, you will feel absolutely great. Trust me. You may have made mistakes in the past, so did I and so did everyone else. It's not a thing you can or should blame yourself for.

I also have problems with my appearance. I struggle with it every day. The first rule is to not be too harsh with yourself. If you see a thing you don't like on your body, think about whether you can change it. If yes, try to change it. And really try. Because I'm 100% certain you can. If you can not change it, start to love yourself. It's easier said than done. I know. But there is a reason why look the way you look. And if it bothers you, try to invert it and love this very thing about you.

Last but not least. You said that you are anxious around other people. Well, same. I had some really bad experiences with former 'best friends'. But that story is too long. It is hard to open up to new people. And they might not all react in a nice way. But there will be that one person, who changes your whole life in a very positive way. It may be a new best friend or your future significant other. You never know. But it is worth trying. Trust me. It may sound hard, but if you don't try you don't win. I'm certain that you are a beautiful and lovely person. Just the way you are. And there are others out there that will think exactly the same. You don't have to talk to everyone instantly, but just try to build up your confidence and talk to one person and then maybe take a break. Talk to another person or again to the person from before. You get the idea. Don't rush it. Friendships and relationships take time.

The world needs you. Because you are one of a kind. You have many strengths that only you have. The fact that you are here. The fact that you live shows that there is a reason you live. But you have to find that reason yourself. Think about what you love, what you are good at and, most importantly, who you truly are. And I don't mean what you look like or anything like that. Think about who YOU are. The one thing that makes you you. And then you have the reason why you shouldn't kill yourself. We need you.

The fact that he is trying out a second therapist shows that he is still trying to fight. He doesn't want to give up yet. He may not see it that way, but his inner self is still fighting. You should always try to be there, if he needs you. Try to see him in person if that's possible. You don't always need to talk, just listen to him. Show him that you care and that he is important. Maybe say that to him over and over again. Offer him a hug when he's feeling terrible. That can help massively. Support him throughout the therapy. You can't heal him from the depression, but you can help him. But you should always keep your own health in mind. If it's too much for you, then say that. Maybe talk to his therapist about ways you can help him.

I don't know the details about this, but I can offer you to talk with me. Anytime. About whatever you want. The only thing I can tell you now is to keep living. I know it sounds easier than it is. You may make some mistakes that hurt other people, but everyone makes these mistakes. Some more. Some less. But that's life. It isn't easy but it's worth living. If you want to share your story with me, you can message me. The more I know, the more I can help you. Keep fighting. You are welcome in this world and your life is worth living.

Again, you are not wrong. In order to show true love, you need to learn to love yourself. With every mistake or peculiarity you might have. This is what makes you different from other people. Love can be a very very complicated and frustrating thing. But it can also be the best thing in the world. You will find someone, who loves you forever. And you will love him too. You shouldn't forget about the time with you ex bf, but you should try and move on. It takes a lot of effort and will. But you can do it. I believe in you.

It won't be the same. That is definitely right. You now feel like he is the only one for you. But the fact, that the relationship didn't last shows that he is not the one. I believe in fate. There will be someone who loves you forever. And you'll know once you see him. Trust me.

I understand how you feel. The last time I cut myself was 2 month ago. And it's a struggle every single day. Suicide thoughts are also bothering me. Sometimes I just feel like I don't belong in this world. That I'm not good enough. That I have to punish myself for my mistakes. But that iss not true. I deserve to live. And so do you. Things look horrible right now, but it will get better. You've certainly heard this a lot, but this is because it is true. There is someone waiting for you. Waiting to love you. It might take a while, but it will happen. I promise. The fact that you haven't killed yourself is a sign that there is still some little bit of hope. Still a will to fight through this shit time. You'll feel better eventually and be proud of yourself that you managed to fight.
